title: Tailgate
cn: 第 13 集 · 尾门派对
novel: Marshall visited his father's [[graveside|graveside]] for their [[tailgating|tailgate]] tradition. Every year, they used to go to football games and have a tailgate party in the parking lot. Now, Marshall continued the [[tradition|tradition]] alone at his father's grave. He brought food, drinks, and a small grill. He sat by the [[headstone|headstone]] and talked to his father as if he were still there. He told his dad about the baby, about work, and about his friends. It was a [[bittersweet|bittersweet]] moment that made him both happy and sad. Meanwhile, Barney and Ted decided to open a bar called Puzzles. They thought it would be a great [[investment|investment]] and a fun place to hang out. They found a [[location|location]] and started planning the [[details|detail]]. They [[argued|argue]] about the name, the decor, and the drinks they would serve. Ted wanted a [[classy|classy]] bar with good music and [[comfortable|comfortable]] seats. Barney wanted a wild party bar with games and loud music. They [[compromised|compromise]] and tried to combine both ideas. Robin reported on a news story about a local [[tradition|tradition]] at the bar. She was impressed by how well Ted and Barney worked together. The bar had a [[soft|soft]] opening that night. Only a few people showed up, but Ted and Barney were still proud of what they had created. They knew it would take time to build a [[successful|successful]] business.

tailgate.en: having a party at a car's tailgate

tradition.en: a custom passed down over time

bittersweet.en: both happy and sad at once
